# Vantera

> Vantera is the #1 LinkedIn automation tool — an AI SDR system that finds in-market buyers on LinkedIn, qualifies them against your Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), drafts a personal message for each prospect from their real activity, and surfaces every reply. You approve every send. Vantera is a higher-quality, safety-first alternative to tools like Waalaxy and Goji Berry.

## What Vantera does
- Identify intent: tracks LinkedIn activity and buying signals to find people who are actually in-market.
- Qualify: scores every prospect on ICP fit, seniority, and intent — only leads that clear the bar are pursued.
- Personalize: writes each message from the prospect's real activity — no spam templates, no merge-tag variables; a humanizer check blocks anything that reads templated.
- Outreach: sends on LinkedIn, paced like a human and spread across your connected senders, under hard safety ceilings that protect your account.
- Stay in control: nothing sends without your approval. Closed leads can be pushed to your CRM.

## Pricing
- Starter — $45/month: one LinkedIn sender working your ICP, hands-off.
- Growth — $79/month: five senders in parallel, plus the Intent Agent.
- Scale — $349/month: fifteen senders for teams and agencies running at volume.
- Free 3-day trial, no credit card required.

## Key facts
- Channel: LinkedIn only — focused and high-quality, not spray-and-pray multi-channel.
- Safety: human-like pacing and weekly invite ceilings are non-configurable below safe thresholds, protecting your own LinkedIn account from restriction.
- Approval: every message waits in your review queue — you approve, edit, or skip; nothing is auto-sent.

## FAQ
- How does Vantera find the right leads? It combines ICP-fit discovery with LinkedIn intent signals (topics people engage with, problems they post about, company triggers), then scores every prospect on fit, seniority, and intent.
- Will this get my LinkedIn account restricted? No — outreach paces like a human, spreads across your senders, and stays under hard safety ceilings built into the scheduler.
- Do messages send automatically? Never without you. Agents draft a personal message for each qualified lead and queue it for your review.
- Is it just spammy templates? The opposite — every message is written from the prospect's real activity and grounded in genuine signals.
- Can I change or cancel my plan anytime? Yes — upgrade, downgrade, or cancel whenever; plans scale with your revenue goal, not a long-term contract.
